frames.title: Lesson 23 · Hardly / scarcely — production and review

body: **Foco:** Hardly / scarcely — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** entrevista.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir e revisar frases com hardly/scarcely/no sooner numa entrevista com um gerente de projetos.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.intro: A project manager reviews a hectic year.
qa: **Hardly had** we announced the date **when** the orders poured in. **No sooner had** the system recovered **than** a second wave arrived. **Scarcely** a day passed without a crisis.
**Hardly ever** do plans survive contact with reality. **Had** we **planned** for peaks, we **would have coped**. Nowadays, **barely** a week goes by without a stress test.

items.q: Orders arrived only after a delay.
A day rarely passed without a crisis.
The firm now runs stress tests weekly.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Hardly had we announced it when orders poured in.**
**No sooner had it recovered than a wave arrived.**
**Scarcely a day passed without a crisis.**

blocks.body: Revise suas frases: (1) **had + particípio** no 1º evento? (2) **when/than** corretos? (3) sem negativa dupla?

items.s: Hardly had we announced the date ___ orders poured in. (when)
No sooner had it recovered ___ a wave arrived. (than)
Scarcely a day ___ without a crisis. (passed)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Scarcely a day passed without a crisis
items.pt: Quase nenhum dia passou sem uma crise.

body: **Hit the fan.** — Dar problema sério.
**Plan for the worst.** — Planejar para o pior.
**Put out fires.** — Apagar incêndios.
**Pull through.** — Superar.
**Ride it out.** — Aguentar até passar.
**All hands on deck.** — Todos a postos.
**Keep a cool head.** — Manter a calma.
**A baptism of fire.** — Batismo de fogo.
**Scarcely a day passed without a crisis.** — Quase nenhum dia passou sem uma crise.
**Hardly had we announced the date when orders poured in.** — Mal anunciamos a data e os pedidos chegaram aos montes.
**No sooner had the system recovered than a second wave came.** — Mal o sistema se recuperou e veio uma segunda onda.

blocks.title: Project talk
lines: Hardly had we announced the date when orders poured in.
Mal anunciamos a data e os pedidos chegaram aos montes.
No sooner had the system recovered than a second wave came.
Mal o sistema se recuperou e veio uma segunda onda.
Scarcely a day passed without a crisis.
Quase nenhum dia passou sem uma crise.
Had we planned for peaks, we would have coped.
Se tivéssemos planejado para os picos, teríamos dado conta.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: Hardly ever do I work late.
Had we planned, we would have coped.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences about a stressful project, using hardly/scarcely/no sooner correctly.
blocks.model: Hardly had we announced the date when orders poured in. No sooner had the system recovered than a second wave arrived. Scarcely a day passed without a crisis. Hardly ever do plans survive reality. Had we planned for peaks, we would have coped. Barely a week goes by now without a stress test.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
